mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ACCOUNTS account_asset ON account_asset.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN CARDS card_asset ON card_asset.card_id = t.card_id LEFT JOIN CONNECTIONS account_connection ON account_connection.connection_id = account_asset.connection_id LEFT JOIN CONNECTIONS card_connection ON card_connection.connection_id = card_asset.connection_id

AND ( ( t.account_id IS NOT NULL AND account_connection.user_id = t.user_id AND account_connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_connection.deleted_at IS NULL ) OR ( t.card_id IS NOT NULL AND card_connection.user_id = t.user_id AND card_connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND card_connection.deleted_at IS NULL ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS cardSpentYtd, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN c.card_type = 'CREDIT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS creditCardSpentYtd, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN c.card_type = 'CHECK' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS checkCardSpentYtd FROM TRANSACTIONS t INNER JOIN CARDS c ON c.card_id = t.card_id INNER JOIN CONNECTIONS card_connection ON card_connection.connection_id = c.connection_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.category NOT IN ('CARD_WITHDRAWAL', 'SEND', 'INCOME', 'LOAN_REPAYMENT') AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'CHECK') AND card_connection.user_id = t.user_id AND card_connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND card_connection.deleted_at IS NULL
